title: 輸水管線洩漏聲學定位
titleEn: Acoustic leak location in water mains
summary: 本課將漏水聲源、傳播速度、雙點到時差與管內追蹤串成完整定位問題，特別分析同步誤差、取樣、頻帶、衰減及共同干擾。學徒須區分漏水存在、位置與流量三種證據，再以盲測和修復回饋檢查方法的真正成效，不以單一漂亮相關峰作結論。
summaryEn: This course connects leak-sound generation, propagation speed, two-sensor delay and inline tracking into a complete location problem, examining synchronization, sampling, frequency bands, attenuation and shared interference. Learners distinguish evidence of leak presence, location and flow, then use blinded tests and repair feedback to assess actual performance instead of relying on one attractive correlation peak.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度例假設兩感測器沿管相距200 m、延遲定義為tB−tA=0.040 s。採波速1000 m/s得到距A為80 m；僅將速度提高10%至1100 m/s，位置改為78 m，移動2 m。另若時差有正1 ms偏移，在原波速下位置改為79.5 m。這兩種偏差不能靠重複處理相同訊號消除。應以獨立管長、同步測試及另一組感測器縮小搜尋區，再透過現地確認或修復前後證據驗證。此算例未假設真實漏點大小，也沒有將位置區間當成開挖許可。
workedExample.textEn: An original sensitivity example has sensors 200 m apart along the pipe and delay tB−tA=0.040 s. Speed 1000 m/s gives a location 80 m from A. Raising only speed by 10% to 1100 m/s moves it to 78 m, a 2 m shift. Separately, a positive 1 ms timing offset at the original speed gives 79.5 m. Reprocessing the same records cannot eliminate either bias. Use independent length, synchronization tests and another sensor arrangement to constrain the search, followed by field confirmation or before-and-after repair evidence. The example assumes no actual leak size and does not turn a location interval into excavation authorization.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」與「雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" and "Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏口能量與聲源形成」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leak energy and acoustic generation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。裂縫形狀、土壤包覆、管材及水壓會同時改變水力與聲學耦合；較大的漏口也可能產生較低頻或較弱的聲音，因此不能按音量直接排序所有漏失量。孔口式只估給定幾何與係數下的流量，不預測聲壓級；裂縫面積隨壓力變動時，固定孔口模型也需重新檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏口能量與聲源形成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. Leakage rate and audible strength are not in a one-to-one relationship. Crack geometry, surrounding soil, pipe material and pressure affect hydraulic and acoustic coupling together. A larger opening can produce lower-frequency or weaker sound, so loudness cannot rank every leak by discharge. The orifice expression estimates flow for specified geometry and coefficient, not acoustic level. If crack area changes with pressure, the fixed-opening model also requires reassessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leak energy and acoustic generation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏口能量與聲源形成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leak energy and acoustic generation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。

相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏口能量與聲源形成」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leak energy and acoustic generation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s, not an inference from loudness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。
某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。

optionsEn: Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias.
The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏口能量與聲源形成」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leak energy and acoustic generation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。以已知訓練漏點或經核准的修復前後資料驗證，不將未校準的麥克風振幅直接當成漏水量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions. Validate against known training leaks or approved before-and-after repair observations rather than converting uncalibrated microphone amplitude directly into leakage volume. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同孔口在兩個假設壓差下的流量，另列聲源與傳播尚需哪些資料。要求調查報告分開漏水存在、位置與流量三種結論，不讓聲音證據超出可支持範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare one hypothetical opening at two pressure differences and list additional source and propagation information needed. Keep conclusions about leak presence, location and flow separate so acoustic evidence is not overstated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Following only the loudest sound can miss a quiet large opening or mistake normal valve and pump noise for leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions. Validate against known training leaks or approved before-and-after repair observations rather than converting uncalibrated microphone amplitude directly into leakage volume.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification"?
options: 將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。
optionsEn: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location.
quiz.explanation: 將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏口能量與聲源形成」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leak energy and acoustic generation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Following only the loudest sound can miss a quiet large opening or mistake normal valve and pump noise for leakage. Incorrect discharge ranking then directs investigation and repair resources away from the actual loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔口式只估給定幾何與係數下的流量，不預測聲壓級；裂縫面積隨壓力變動時，固定孔口模型也需重新檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If crack area changes with pressure, the fixed-opening model also requires reassessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「雙點到時差與定位」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 同一漏聲沿管線往兩端傳播，兩支感測器的到時差可把聲源限制在已知管段內。座標方向與延遲符號必須明確，否則同一數值會得到鏡像位置；管長應沿實際管路量測而不是兩測點的地表直線距離，分支與材質變化則可能使單速模型不再適用。定義x自感測器A量起、Δt=tB−tA，且聲源位於A與B之間；兩側共用相同波速時才有此代數關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙點到時差與定位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A leak signal travels toward both ends of a pipe, and its arrival-time difference constrains the source within a known reach. Coordinate direction and delay sign must be explicit or the same number yields a mirrored location. Length follows the actual pipe rather than a straight surface distance, while branches and material transitions can invalidate a single-speed model. Define x from sensor A and Δt=tB−tA, with the source between A and B. The algebraic relation requires the same wave speed on both sides. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Two-sensor delay and location” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.040 s，x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m，自A沿管量測；至B為120 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, a=1000 m/s and Δt=0.040 s. x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m along the pipe from A, leaving 120 m to B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-sensor delay and location” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.040 s，x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m，自A沿管量測；至B為120 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, a=1000 m/s and Δt=0.040 s. x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m along the pipe from A, leaving 120 m to B. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在資料檔中固定A、B編號與延遲正負定義，核對實際管路長度及中途閥件。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙點到時差與定位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-sensor delay and location” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在資料檔中固定A、B編號與延遲正負定義，核對實際管路長度及中途閥件。改變感測器配置再作獨立相關，確認推定位置在共同地圖上重疊，而不是只重複同一組訊號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix sensor A and B identifiers and the delay-sign convention in the data file, verifying pipe length and intervening fittings. Repeat correlation with an independent sensor arrangement and check overlapping map locations rather than merely reprocessing the same signals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出聲源到兩端的傳播路徑，用各自距離除以波速重新求延遲，反查定位結果。再交換感測器名稱，確認物理位置不變而座標與延遲符號一致轉換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw propagation paths to both sensors and recompute delay from each distance divided by speed. Then exchange sensor names, confirming that the physical location stays fixed while coordinates and delay sign transform consistently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 定位公式把管長、速度及延遲誤差一起傳到位置，誤差的來源與相關性必須分開。固定時間偏移會沿同一方向移動全部結果，而隨機雜訊會使重複估計散布；只報演算法相關峰的寬度，不能涵蓋管材速度或儀器時鐘的系統偏差。
knowledge.textEn: The location formula propagates length, speed and delay errors into position, requiring their sources and correlations to remain distinct. A fixed timing offset shifts all results in one direction, whereas random noise spreads repeated estimates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。
定位公式把管長、速度及延遲誤差一起傳到位置，誤差的來源與相關性必須分開。
取樣率加倍就必定讓現場定位誤差減少一半。
optionsEn: Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias.
The location formula propagates length, speed and delay errors into position, requiring their sources and correlations to remain distinct.
Doubling sample rate necessarily halves the field location error.
quiz.explanation: 定位公式把管長、速度及延遲誤差一起傳到位置，誤差的來源與相關性必須分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The location formula propagates length, speed and delay errors into position, requiring their sources and correlations to remain distinct. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度與同步誤差傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=0.040 s、速度誤差δa=+100 m/s，δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m；另有1 ms時差偏移可造成0.50 m位置偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=0.040 s and speed error δa=+100 m/s. δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m. A separate 1 ms delay offset at a=1000 m/s produces a 0.50 m shift. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同訊號測試兩通道的相對延遲，再以獨立管長資料約束幾何誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test relative channel delay with a common signal and constrain geometry using independent pipe-length information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度與同步誤差傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同訊號測試兩通道的相對延遲，再以獨立管長資料約束幾何誤差。將速度、時間與路徑各自列成誤差項，對系統偏差採情境比較，對可證明獨立的隨機量才使用統計合成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test relative channel delay with a common signal and constrain geometry using independent pipe-length information. List speed, timing and route errors separately, using scenario comparisons for systematic bias and statistical combination only for demonstrably independent random quantities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對同一定位結果分別加入速度偏差與時差偏移，標示兩者移動方向。寫出包含共同偏差的搜尋區間，並說明哪一項額外量測最能縮小區間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add speed bias and timing offset separately to one location estimate, marking their shift directions. Report a search interval that includes common bias and identify the additional measurement most capable of narrowing it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩通道之間固定的相對時鐘偏移可能在重複測試中完全穩定，卻使所有漏點位置一起偏離；把這種偏差當成可平均消除的雜訊，會給出過窄的開挖搜尋區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A stable relative clock offset can persist through repeated tests and shift all inferred locations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度與同步誤差傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 兩通道之間固定的相對時鐘偏移可能在重複測試中完全穩定，卻使所有漏點位置一起偏離；把這種偏差當成可平均消除的雜訊，會給出過窄的開挖搜尋區。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Treating that bias as noise removable by averaging produces an unjustifiably narrow excavation search interval. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling interval and location resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離散取樣把到時差表示為時間格點，較高取樣率可以縮小格點間隔，但不會自動提高實際定位準確度。抗混疊濾波、訊號頻寬、感測器耦合及雜訊決定可用資訊，次取樣插值也不能憑空創造遺失頻率；應分開理論格點尺度與經驗證的現地誤差。本例假設均勻波速且只考慮一個取樣間隔的延遲變化，不包含頻寬限制與峰值估計誤差，也不是可保證的定位精度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣間隔與定位解析」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discrete sampling represents delay on a time grid, and higher sample rate reduces grid spacing without automatically improving actual location accuracy. Anti-alias filtering, signal bandwidth, sensor coupling and noise determine usable information. The example assumes uniform speed and considers one sample interval of delay only. It excludes bandwidth and peak-estimation error and is not a guaranteed positioning accuracy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling interval and location resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻帶選擇與色散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Band selection and dispersion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。保留濾波前後資料與相位處理方式，避免後續分析者無法重現延遲估計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation. Retain records before and after filtering with the phase-processing method so later analysts can reproduce the delay estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同一資料的低頻與高頻定位並排，列出速度、衰減與干擾三種可能原因。要求每次濾波選擇都有可重現的依據，避免為得到預期位置反覆挑選頻帶。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Place low- and high-band locations side by side and list speed, attenuation and interference as alternative explanations. Require a reproducible reason for each filter choice rather than selecting bands until a desired position appears.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻帶選擇與色散」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Band selection and dispersion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. Ignoring dispersion can also create contradictory locations across bands without any obvious instrument malfunction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波長公式只連結某頻率與其對應相速度，不把波長當定位誤差；存在色散時，不同頻帶須使用相容的傳播模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With dispersion, different bands need compatible propagation models.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證」與「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification" and "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attenuation and sensor coupling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏聲到達感測器前會經過管壁、接頭與地層，傳播損失和接觸耦合都可能降低振幅。兩測點訊號差異不一定代表一端離漏點更遠，鬆動的感測器或不同閥件可造成額外損失；衰減模型應以相同安裝與頻帶比較，不能把單次振幅比直接解成距離。指數衰減是單一頻帶、均勻路徑的教學模型，α為振幅衰減係數；功率比需平方，不能混用二十分貝與十分貝定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before reaching a sensor, leak sound passes through pipe walls, joints and surrounding ground, while both propagation loss and contact coupling reduce amplitude. Unequal signals do not necessarily mean one sensor is farther from the leak: loose attachment or different fittings can add loss. Attenuation comparisons require matched installation and band, rather than interpreting one amplitude ratio directly as distance. Exponential decay is a teaching model for one band and uniform path, with α an amplitude attenuation coefficient. Power ratios are squared, so amplitude and power decibel definitions must not be mixed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attenuation and sensor coupling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設α=0.010 m⁻¹、d=100 m，A/A0=e^(−αd)=0.3679；振幅變化20log10(A/A0)=−8.686 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume α=0.010 m⁻¹ and d=100 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Attenuation and sensor coupling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證

knowledge.text: 漏聲到達感測器前會經過管壁、接頭與地層，傳播損失和接觸耦合都可能降低振幅。兩測點訊號差異不一定代表一端離漏點更遠，鬆動的感測器或不同閥件可造成額外損失；衰減模型應以相同安裝與頻帶比較，不能把單次振幅比直接解成距離。

Unequal signals do not necessarily mean one sensor is farther from the leak: loose attachment or different fittings can add loss.

knowledge.text: 誤解：兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Attenuation and sensor coupling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設α=0.010 m⁻¹、d=100 m，A/A0=e^(−αd)=0.3679；振幅變化20log10(A/A0)=−8.686 dB。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume α=0.010 m⁻¹ and d=100 m. A/A0=e^(−αd)=0.3679, giving amplitude change 20log10(A/A0)=−8.686 dB. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用已知訊號及重複安裝檢查耦合一致性，再比較不同距離的同頻帶振幅。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 共同機械噪聲可產生很高相干性，若把它直接當漏水機率就會累積假警報；短資料窗又可能讓估計波動很大，卻被誤讀成漏口間歇出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared machinery noise can yield high coherence and generate false alarms if interpreted as leak probability. Short records can also create unstable estimates that are mistakenly read as intermittent leakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Coherence lies between zero and one but is not the probability that a leak exists.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 管內移動檢測與定位軌跡機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inline inspection and position tracking” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管內感測器接近漏聲來源，可減少部分外部耦合問題，但聲音時間戳仍須轉換成沿管位置。工具速度不必等於斷面平均流速，停留、翻轉與分岔都會影響軌跡；只有把通過已知位置的事件與移動模型連結，才能避免聲音特徵被標在錯誤管段。恆速乘時間只描述已知工具速度的理想區段，不可直接以水流速度代替；實際定位需使用獨立通過標記或其他追蹤資料。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An inline sensor approaches the acoustic source and can reduce some external coupling problems, but signal timestamps still require conversion into along-pipe position. Tool speed need not equal section-average water velocity; pauses, rotation and branches affect its trajectory. Linking passages at known locations to the motion model prevents acoustic features from being assigned to the wrong reach. Speed times time describes an ideal reach with known tool speed and cannot substitute water velocity without evidence. Real positioning needs independent passage markers or other tracking data. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inline inspection and position tracking” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設已校準工具速度vtool=0.80 m/s、兩事件間Δt=50 s，沿程距離Δx=vtoolΔt=40.0 m，非直接採用管內平均流速。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume calibrated tool speed vtool=0.80 m/s and event interval Δt=50 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「管內移動檢測與定位軌跡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設已校準工具速度vtool=0.80 m/s、兩事件間Δt=50 s，沿程距離Δx=vtoolΔt=40.0 m，非直接採用管內平均流速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Along-pipe distance Δx=vtoolΔt=40.0 m, without equating tool speed to bulk flow. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 將工具時間、外部通過標記及已知閥件位置對時，對每段檢查行進距離是否閉合。若有停滯或速度改變，分段重建軌跡並擴大位置區間，不用全程平均速度掩蓋局部異常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

quiz.question: 在「盲測驗證與修復回饋機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Blind validation and repair feedback mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只公布已開挖且成功的漏點會排除假警報與漏檢，使效能被高估；修復後用水量下降若未校正需求及壓力，也可能被錯誤全歸功於漏水修復。
漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reporting only excavated successful locations excludes false alarms and misses, overstating performance.
Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
quiz.explanation: 只公布已開挖且成功的漏點會排除假警報與漏檢，使效能被高估；修復後用水量下降若未校正需求及壓力，也可能被錯誤全歸功於漏水修復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting only excavated successful locations excludes false alarms and misses, overstating performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
